app.title: JupyterGIS 0.16: a grammar of graphics for maps, and collaborative story maps
app.author: arjxn-py
app.description: A Jupyter extension that provides declarative grammar‑of‑graphics mapping capabilities and collaborative story‑mapping for interactive geospatial visualizations.
proposed_tests: Clone repo, install via pip install -e ., verify that `import jupytergis` succeeds
Create a minimal notebook that plots a GeoJSON file using jupytergis, confirm map renders without errors
Run the collaborative story‑map example and verify that multiple users can edit in the same notebook session
Measure load time for a 50k‑point GeoJSON dataset to benchmark performance
